title: Society Wives · Episode 04B · Society Chotu after office: five distinct home/society encounters
scope: Adds one short after-work society/helper track per lead, after each lead's pre-existing office Chotu scene and colleague encounters; preserves those existing scenes and their locks.
comparisonRule: One step bolder in chosen visual styling and active adult agency relative to that lead's office scene; NOT a repeat of accidents, kissing, nude exposure or generic sustained embraces.
locks: Five adult society helpers distinct from office Chotu, ages confirmed as 22 or 23.
No twins Jan2 in work or society tracks.
No kissing or explicit sex/groping; deliberate provocative but non-nude styling and freely welcomed physical contact only.

Children are outside any attraction scene and cared for separately. Spouses, siblings and elders cannot disappear solely to clear a romantic room; unconfirmed Jan2 household clocks remain explicitly unconfirmed.
No voyeur, photo, CCTV, forced view or work-service coercion. A helper may decline personal attention without consequence.
Do not repeat Jan1 backdrop, buttons, or prior user-rejected Jan2 car hatch, tipped kettle, collapsing tray, AV feedback, paper binder accident.
Meenakshi's car stopped near the badminton court on Jan1; repair or movement must be checked, never silently assumed.
Taniya exits CA firm 19:30; Ankita 18:15; Shivani 16:30; Shreya station 18:20; Meenakshi hospital 18:00.
Office action locks from Jan2 remain intact. Society scenes are distinct from office settings and appear chronologically after them.
Soniya is a sixth woman on the shared society Guddu track and NOT one of these five; her prior author-corrected 1 Jan history remains separate.

leads.name: Shivani
leads.officeCarryover: Sunny staff-only rehearsal includes controlled shoulder/upper-back reveal and a welcomed upper-back caress; Shivani was unexpectedly disarmed by his reserve.
leads.visualSignature: Deep-back cultural-event blouse with draped sari showing shoulder line, open upper/lower back and side waist under warm event lights. One controlled reveal, not undressing.
leads.chosenAction: Deliberate waist-and-back display; consensual side-waist hold during a 3-count partner silhouette; no second upper-back caress.
leads.personalEscalation: Unlike the earlier Sunny AV backstage turn, she now allows Deepu to hold a still, slightly longer two-person stage silhouette after explicitly asking. She is the one who breaks the hold when she recognizes she enjoys being watched.

scenes.title: Home reset and legitimate cultural errand
scenes.location: Shivani apartment and society cultural-service area

beats.title: After college and family checkpoint
beats.action: After leaving the college at 16:30, Shivani is back at society. Household rhythms for Tara/Rohan/Kavya remain real, but their precise Jan2 positions need confirmation. Any adult styling happens away from Tara.

beats.title: A reason for Deepu to be there
beats.action: Deepu is finishing leftover New Year cultural backdrop/light adjustments in the society atrium. Shivani is already associated with the cultural rehearsal; he requests her judgement on how fabric silhouettes read from a short viewing distance. This is not a fake wardrobe malfunction or a repeat of yesterday's backdrop accident.

beats.title: Visual—entire drape rather than AV-booth partial turn
beats.action: Shivani deliberately presents the deeper back and side-waist cut of her selected event sari under the rehearsal light. She pauses facing the marked light, then turns to display the full outline to Deepu. Her choice is confident and clear.
beats.bodyParts: Shoulders, open upper and lower back, side waist; neckline
beats.actionName: Deliberate fuller back-and-waist reveal; controlled silhouette pose
beats.sightline: Adult-only setup lane, no students, children, uninvolved spectators or cameras

beats.title: Physical step—not Sunny's caress again
beats.action: With no task pressure, Shivani asks if Deepu wants to hold a brief paired pose to check the mark; if he clearly agrees, she takes his forearm and guides him to a light side-waist placement for one slow three-count pose. He releases as she steps away.
beats.actionName: Mutually agreed side-waist hold and three-count still pose
beats.limits: No kiss, nudity, chest groping, or equipment failure. Deepu can decline without any work consequence.

beats.title: Her own surprise
beats.action: Shivani expected to tease him, but she holds the silence a beat longer and has to consciously end it. His reaction is not automatically narrated as a promise; he simply takes a measured breath and returns to the actual event setup.
beats.psychological: Instead of being amused by a flustered assistant, she surprises herself by wanting an honest look from someone already familiar.

scenes.title: Family continuity after the society rehearsal

beats.title: No invented witness or twin crossover
beats.action: Shivani returns upstairs, checks on the family according to their yet-to-be-set Jan2 schedule, and changes into ordinary evening clothes. No twins, no second Deepu visit or secret plot created.

leads.name: Ankita
leads.officeCarryover: Rohit office scene: Annie intentionally styled a deep neckline and visible waist and initiated a brief consensual waist hold. Rinku is a different society helper with no approved personal encounter yet.
leads.visualSignature: New Year evening lehenga-style drape with open back, exposed shoulders, side waist and visible midriff, with a light wrap she intentionally leaves off while judging décor light.
leads.chosenAction: Open-back and waist display; consensual lower-back-guided single pose, no second generic waist hold identical to Rohit.
leads.personalEscalation: The social risk is inviting a known building helper to see her in off-duty attire and then openly acknowledging the fact she chose not to cover up. She is self-aware, less performative than with Rohit; Rinku's consent and distance remain essential.

scenes.title: Return after the Cyber City office
scenes.location: Ankita apartment → shared society décor corridor

beats.title: Travel and real household
beats.action: Ankita finishes work at 18:15 and reaches Gurgaon society afterward; exact commute depends on traffic. Kabir, Rhea and other household positions are not arbitrarily rearranged just to clear the flat.

beats.title: Rinku has a real service job
beats.action: Rinku is the society helper assigned to collect a leftover New Year LED dimmer and safely remove decorative wiring in the shared corridor. He is not suddenly a photographer, romantic confidant or participant in yesterday's Rohit encounter.

scenes.title: Ankita's open-back choice
scenes.location: Shared corridor decoration niche visible from common passage

beats.title: New visual accent
beats.action: After getting ready for the evening at home, Ankita steps out in a deliberately chosen, more open-back festive drape that also shows her side waist and midriff. She removes the loose wrap she would normally use and looks toward Rinku only after he has finished the electrical safety check.
beats.bodyParts: Open back, shoulders, visible side waist and midriff; neckline
beats.actionName: Intentional full back/waist reveal with wrap set aside
beats.sightline: Common-space alcove with no secret locked room and no child involvement

beats.title: A personal choice, no fabricated rescue
beats.action: Ankita asks what the costume outline looks like from the newly adjusted light rather than claiming a genuine accident. If Rinku is comfortable, the two hold a single non-recorded standing portrait-like pose with his hand lightly at her lower back over/at the garment edge; she directs and ends the pose.
beats.actionName: Consensual guided lower-back pose; one still moment
beats.limits: Do not film, photograph, grope, or imply the building helper owes consent to a resident.

beats.title: Reaction stays grounded
beats.action: Ankita enjoys not hiding that she invited his opinion but notices how different a society encounter feels from a familiar office support role. Rinku responds in his own words without automatically adopting Rohit's shyness.
beats.psychological: Her thrill comes from openly choosing a new context, not repeating the previous two-button test or a second accident.

beats.title: After-effect without an invented family spectacle
beats.action: Ankita continues her household evening. Kabir's presence remains an existing marriage track; no invented overhearing, twin visit or encounter with an adult viewer is asserted.

leads.name: Taniya
leads.officeCarryover: Punit office scene: Taniya deliberately wears a wedding-related outfit with neckline/midriff visible and invites a consensual close pose with brief waist contact. Her engagement to Aditya remains intact.
leads.visualSignature: A distinct home-trial bridal blouse with open-back cut, bare shoulders and midriff, paired with a drape she consciously adjusts for her own mirror evaluation; not the same office outfit.
leads.chosenAction: Chosen open-back + midriff presentation, and consensual side-by-side back/waist framing pose in front of the doorway mirror without copying a bridal measurement.
leads.personalEscalation: Taniya's normal audit sarcasm is still there, but this time she feels more nervous because the other visitor already has a separate unusual history with her sister Soniya; that hidden history is not magically known to her.

beats.title: Travel is not skipped
beats.action: Taniya leaves the CA firm only at 19:30, then travels to society. She does not materialize at home at 19:45. Soniya and Rahul keep their independent Jan2 routines; neither is silently deleted.

beats.title: Why Guddu returns
beats.action: Guddu arrives for the pre-established wedding quotation follow-up. He has a separate, unusually bold prior Jan1 Soniya encounter; Taniya does not automatically know exactly what happened. He remains professionally cautious and is not presumed eager to flirt.

scenes.title: The bridal look she chooses to test
scenes.location: Apartment entrance / adult-only dressing foyer, not a bedroom

beats.title: Different from her Punit scene
beats.action: Taniya has changed into a home-trial wedding blouse/drape with a pronounced open-back design, bare shoulders and midriff. She pauses to evaluate the fit in the entrance mirror, knowingly remaining in the chosen look when Guddu returns rather than improvising a wardrobe fault.
beats.bodyParts: Bare shoulders, open back, midriff, waistline
beats.actionName: Deliberate back-cut reveal with midriff profile
beats.sightline: Adult-only entry area; no child, no nudity, no unauthorized sightline

beats.title: The real social test
beats.action: Guddu brings the actual page or a vendor update, not a fake lost object. Taniya directly asks whether the silhouette looks too formal or suitably festive. If Guddu welcomes the personal exchange, they make a single side-by-side doorway-mirror pose with his arm lightly around her side waist after a spoken check.
beats.actionName: Consensual side-by-side mirror pose with waist framing
beats.limits: He can opt out while completing courier work; no photos, kisses or groping.

beats.title: Taniya checks herself
beats.action: The assertive bride-to-be expected to crack a joke, but she is privately struck by her own wish for Guddu to notice. It does not imply she forgot fiancé Aditya or suddenly knows about Soniya.
beats.psychological: The point is a conscious risk to her own self-image, not a revived wedding-vendor measurement gag.

beats.title: No invented sister witness
beats.action: Taniya returns to her normal evening. Soniya and Rahul's actual whereabouts must be checked before prose; no fabricated accidental witness, interruption or disclosure of Soniya's earlier encounter.

leads.name: Shreya
leads.officeCarryover: Station tea-helper scene has an off-duty civilian neckline display and consensual close frontal embrace. Chintu is instead the society security helper from the Jan1 broken-buttons incident.
leads.visualSignature: Intentional deep-back and sleeveless evening sari look, visible shoulders, upper back and side waist; avoids repeating yesterday's uniform-button accident.
leads.chosenAction: A purposeful still reveal and a brief mutually agreed side-waist framing hold—NO second front embrace or damaged shirt.
leads.personalEscalation: Shreya knows what happened to her uniform after the Jan1 latch incident but does not know exactly what Chintu saw; in her own chosen clothes she tests whether she can be seen without the accident defining the encounter.

scenes.title: From station to society, not two places at once

beats.title: Time and family anchor
beats.action: Shreya ends her station interaction by 18:20 and commutes. At home Anaya's care is separately arranged, Vikram's Jan2 return is not yet confirmed, and Arvind's private track must not be conflated with Chintu.

beats.title: Prior personal history stays single
beats.action: Chintu is not new. He remembers the one Jan1 latch incident, and Shreya is aware of the unexpected button damage only after reaching home that evening. No invented follow-up view or second tearing incident.

scenes.title: A chosen look without the uniform accident
scenes.location: Society security-desk side corridor / publicly accessible foyer

beats.title: Visual from choice, not damage
beats.action: Shreya returns in a deliberate sleeveless evening sari with open upper back, visible shoulders, a defined neckline and draped side waist. As she checks the visitor return confirmation, she deliberately stands without a shawl and turns enough for Chintu to see the styling rather than hiding the new outfit.
beats.bodyParts: Shoulders, collarbone, open upper back, side waist, neckline
beats.sightline: Accessible security/foyer area; no private home access or imagined voyeur

beats.title: An explicitly separate voluntary step
beats.action: After Chintu closes the register work, Shreya tentatively asks if he would be comfortable standing beside her for one brief, posed line-of-sight test; only if he accepts does she guide his hand to her side waist over the sari edge, then release and return to her evening.
beats.limits: No police rank pressure; no kiss, no second frontal embrace, no security camera footage treated as romance.

beats.title: A more difficult uncertainty
beats.action: Chintu's earlier shock had belonged to an accident; now Shreya knowingly observes his reaction to an outfit she selected. She cannot simply read his thoughts or conclude he saw more in the Jan1 incident than he admits.
beats.psychological: For Shreya, the controlled choice creates more vulnerability than the ripped-button scene.

scenes.title: The mother and officer continue home

beats.title: Child care remains nonsexual
beats.action: Shreya returns to Anaya and her normal household responsibilities. Anaya is never present during or referenced inside the adult Chintu interaction; Sameer/Shruti's Jan2 return dates remain undefined; no twins.

leads.name: Meenakshi
leads.officeCarryover: Naveen hospital scene uses a consciously chosen sari-pallu reveal and consensual waist embrace after duty. The old Babloo car-hatch accident and earlier office Naveen binder scenes were rejected.
leads.visualSignature: Draped open-back evening sari with uncovered shoulders, visible side waist/midriff and defined neckline, with hair moved aside to show blouse design. This must be distinct from the black-lace Nikhil marital surprise.
leads.chosenAction: Intentional extended open-back presentation with hair moved aside, followed by a single mutually welcomed low-back pose; do NOT repeat the office waist embrace.
leads.personalEscalation: Meenakshi normally balances warm professionalism and family duties; choosing to meet Babloo in a self-selected off-duty look after already making an unexpected choice at the hospital unsettles her. It is not a substitute for her Vihaan care or Nikhil's marriage track.

scenes.title: Hospital exit, child-care checkpoint and genuine car news

beats.title: A working mother's return
beats.action: Meenakshi leaves hospital at 18:00 and returns to the household. She checks Vihaan's family care and lactation routine. Her baby's designated carer during the workday is not invented.

beats.title: Car is still a real continuity problem
beats.action: Babloo, the already familiar society pharmacy helper, calls or messages with a status update on the stalled car from Jan1. A mechanic report/quote may be available but the vehicle is NOT assumed repaired, moved or driveable. Babloo has agreed to help with the car since the EP03 18:45–19:00 scene.

scenes.title: Doctor Madam sets the personal terms
scenes.location: Adult-only Kapoor apartment entrance / common foyer

beats.title: A new visual emphasis after the hospital scene
beats.action: After family care Meenakshi changes into a chosen, open-back evening sari/blouse, different from her hospital styling. She knowingly leaves the back design uncovered and gently moves her hair aside when Babloo arrives to discuss the repair update.
beats.bodyParts: Shoulders, upper/lower back, side waist and midriff; defined neckline
beats.actionName: Deliberate full open-back and side-waist display with hair set aside
beats.sightline: Adult-only doorway, no toddler or unrelated elder watching

beats.title: Deliberate conversation, not a car hatch or parcel accident
beats.action: Meenakshi asks whether Babloo would give his personal opinion on the chosen evening sari rather than simply handing over the mechanic status. After asking whether he welcomes the closeness, she steps beside him for one still framed pose and permits a brief light hand at her lower back—different from an office waist embrace.
beats.limits: No sex, genital/breast touching, nudity, kiss, car-hatch accident or invented repair success.

beats.title: The unsettled mature response
beats.action: Meenakshi notes that she initiated a more open personal moment for someone she used to know only as a dependable helper. Babloo responds with confident courtesy rather than repeating the EP03 first compliment verbatim.
beats.psychological: Intentional desire for his attention and relief at being able to choose the encounter, without suddenly erasing affection for Nikhil.

beats.title: Family track and honest unknowns
beats.action: Meenakshi returns to care for Vihaan, waits for further car news if needed, and continues the Nikhil marital track without invented late-night outcomes. Mohan, Dev and Ishita's precise Jan2 location remains unconfirmed; none is scripted to spy on the Babloo encounter.
